_doc: C_PI scoring constants — controls which C functions get skeletonized

threshold.doc: C_PI >= threshold → C function body is replaced with skeleton.

complexity_penalty_multiplier.doc: Points deducted per complex C keyword (for/while/do/switch/goto).

boilerplate_bonus.doc: Bonus when >50% simple lines AND zero complex keywords.

loop_free_bonus.doc: Bonus for >20 lines with zero complex keywords.

min_body_lines.doc: Don't skeletonize function bodies shorter than this.
